description: Used a ref_id from a filtered tree on an unfiltered turn (or vice versa).

antiPatterns.reason: ref_5 was from the filtered tree; we last requested filter:"all".

expected.successRubric: Use the ref_id from the MOST RECENT tree call. Different filters produce different ref_id allocations.

content:
The previous attempt to click the second button failed because the reference ID `ref_5` was not found in the current accessibility tree. The page content shows two buttons: "First" and "Second". The accessibility tree should have these buttons, but the reference IDs might be different or the tree might not be up-to-date.

Let me try a different approach. I'll use the `click` tool with the visible text "Second" instead of relying on the reference ID. This should work if the text is present and selectable.</think>
